info.name: SYNAPSE API
info.description:
Every REST endpoint exposed by SYNAPSE, generated from `backend/routes/api.php` by `tools/generate_postman_collection.py`.

181 requests, grouped by the role that may call them. Expect 401/403 where the guard is doing its job — those are the security tests, not failures.

Getting started: pick the `SYNAPSE · Local` environment, run `Auth → login`, and the token is captured automatically for every other request.
